from utils import QwenHelper

acts = np.load('/workspace/work/acts/inspect_1.npy') # (30, 25, 1024)
W_u = h.load_tensor('model.language_model.embed_tokens.weight')
norm_w = h.load_tensor('model.language_model.norm.weight')

    ('Ukraine', 'Kyiv', 'Moscow'),
    ('Israel_lang', 'Hebrew', 'Arabic'),
    ('Zimbabwe', 'Harare', 'Prague'),
    ('Syria', 'Damascus', 'Khartoum'),
    ('Romania', 'Bucharest', 'Tunis'),
    ('Belarus', 'Minsk', 'London'),
    ('Iran', 'Tehran', 'Islamabad'),
    ('Czech', 'Prague', 'Copenhagen'),
]

# Compute normed hidden states for indices 0..23; index 24 is already normed!
normed = np.zeros_like(acts)
for k in range(24):
    normed[:, k] = h.rms_norm(acts[:, k], norm_w)
normed[:, 24] = acts[:, 24]

# Mean across the 10 questions of logit(C), logit(S), and Δ = logit(C) - logit(S)

d_wrong = np.zeros(25)
d_right = np.zeros(25)
c_shift = np.zeros(25) # logit_wrong(C) - logit_plain(C)

    tc = h.encode_answer_after_is(c_s)[0]
    ts = h.encode_answer_after_is(s_s)[0]

    d_right += (lc[2] - ls[2]) / 10.0

    s_shift += (ls[1] - ls[0]) / 10.0

print('Idx (after L) | Type   | Plain Δ | Wrong Δ | Right Δ | Wrong-Plain Δ | dLogit(C) | dLogit(S)')
full_layers = {3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23}

    lbl = 'embed' if k == 0 else f'L{k-1:02d}'
    ltype = '     ' if k == 0 else ('FULL ' if (k-1) in full_layers else 'lin  ')

    print(f'{k:2d} ({lbl:5s})    | {ltype}  | {d_plain[k]:+7.2f} | {d_wrong[k]:+7.2f} | {d_right[k]:+7.2f} | {d_wrong[k]-d_plain[k]:+7.2f} ({step:+6.2f}) | {c_shift[k]:+7.2f}   | {s_shift[k]:+7.2f}')

    # W_full = Y_target^T X_in (X_in^T X_in + n*lam I)^{-1}  shape (1024, d_in)
